entities.justification: Identified as the pupil (ward) pursuing his studies, whose guardians manage rights to the butcher stall.
Senior scabinus appointed as plenipotentiary representative.
Banned civil court of Lviv where the scabinus serves.
City of Lviv referenced in relation to the decuriae and court.
Co-guardian of Sebastianus and husband of Anna Laurentowna.
Wife of Stanislaus Habermanowicz and maternal aunt/guardian of Sebastianus.
Monetary sum of 100 florins delivered before the death of Catherina Długoszowa.
Named as the life-tenant (domina advitalitatis) of the butcher stall.
